key_insight: Optimised eighth-order Trotter–Suzuki formulas improve theoretical quantum-simulation efficiency, including the first general schemes at this order.
engineering_relevance: These formulas could reduce gate-depth requirements as hardware noise decreases, while second-order Leapfrog remains preferable at current noise levels.
method: Extend product-formula optimisation to eighth order.
Develop improved compositions and general eighth-order schemes.
Evaluate Heisenberg XZ-chain dynamics and noisy circuits using qiskit-omelyan.
evidence_signal: In Heisenberg XZ-chain simulations, at least one of the two recommended schemes consistently outperforms the Morales et al. benchmarks, though the best-performing scheme varies.
watch_item: Performance depends on hardware noise and Hamiltonian splitting; for many non-commuting terms, decomposition uniformity becomes a key indicator.
paper_title: Optimised 8th-Order Trotter-Suzuki Schemes for Quantum Simulation
